Case Studies

Real Results, Real Impact

CFO Services

Engaged by CEO of private-equity purchased agency to drive improved operational efficiencies across forecasting, system integration, talent planning, financial closings, utilization reporting and project management execution — with support to CEO, CFO and GM on strategic matters and board package reporting.

Results Achieved
  • Decreased monthly financial close from 15 days to 5 days across all units
  • New forecast process drives quarterly visibility, staffing and up-tick in quarterly margins
  • Client gross margin improvement ranging from 10% to 15% points
  • Weekly to daily timesheet shift improves talent resourcing process across brands
  • Redefined roles for client service group — shifts finance responsibilities to PM group
CFO Services

Engaged by founders of digital agency to assist in hiring a CEO and to provide operational advice on restructuring business as a creative technology consultancy — including oversight of controller, cash flow modeling, forecasting, restructuring of private debt & bank covenants, staffing alignment, incentive compensation and pricing.

Results Achieved
  • Improved staffing guidance drives P&L from breakeven to 20% margin in one year
  • Refinanced private investor debt from 10% to 4.5% rate with limited financial covenants
  • CEO compensation and equity structure aligned with growth target over 5-year plan
  • Implementation of cash-flow management tool to minimize LOC borrowing
  • Increased average effective billable rate by 30%
  • Improved overall average utilization from 70% to 85% billability
Controller Services

Engaged by a pharmaceutical advertising agency to support their finance department by improving its structure and efficiency — analyzing existing financial processes, identifying inefficiencies and implementing best practices to streamline operations, ensuring compliance with industry regulations and enhancing cost management strategies.

Results Achieved
  • Implementation of new integrated accounting and PM system across 50 staffers
  • Contributed to the creation of the agency's first Business Continuity Plan
  • Improved working capital through collaboration with Senior Client Accounting
  • Developed new weekly dashboard displaying utilization, billability and overservice metrics
  • Played a key role with CFO in sale event to publicly-traded holding company
Controller Services

Engaged by a digital pharmaceutical advertising agency to shift outsource accounting function to in-house — streamlining invoicing, expense management and cash flow tracking while providing key financial insights to support strategic decision-making.

Results Achieved
  • Successfully transitioned accounting process from cash to accrual basis reporting
  • Strengthened company financial oversight and reduced reliance on third-party services
  • Developed standardized financial reporting procedures for C-Suite
  • Established international financial reporting for Singapore affiliate
  • Achieved consistent and timely five-day financial closes
  • Played a key due diligence role with CFO in buyout of affiliated company
CFO Services

Engaged by a real estate development company undergoing a material growth surge — having acquired 15 industrial properties in the past year — to transition off its existing bookkeeping team in early 2025 and build financial infrastructure capable of supporting that scale.

Results Achieved
  • Layered in fractional CFO counsel alongside fractional controller and accounting support, each with real estate specific expertise
  • 2025 tax work completed on schedule despite the transition and rapid portfolio growth
  • 2026 financial reporting current and up to date for all lenders, investors and general partners
  • Financial function now structured to scale across the property and investment tiers
  • Positioned to transition accounting records for 50-plus entities onto a real estate specific ERP heading into 2027
CFO Services

Engaged by ownership of a $60M agency facing sustained losses, breached bank covenants and a lender relationship under strain — brought in to lead an immediate operational and financial restructuring to stabilize the business through the second half of 2025 and rebuild a credible path forward with the bank, shareholders and the entire organization.

Results Achieved
  • Restructuring plan implemented within first 90 days, stabilizing operations and cash flow through second half 2025
  • Rebuilt lender confidence, resulting in a new credit facility and covenant structure heading into 2026
  • Year one performance: 30% earnings margins and 30% top-line growth year over year
  • Ownership fully aligned on strategic direction and growth priorities
  • New business pipeline strengthened, with a robust and repeatable sales cycle in place
  • Agency positioned to launch tuck-in acquisitions in support of its five-year growth strategy

Our Team

The People Behind the Results

David P. Drucker

DCD Consulting Group

David has spent 25 years as a CFO and financial partner, working with pioneering private and PE-backed companies in the marketing and communications (marcom) space. His expertise lies in guiding companies through rapid growth, strategic transformations and successful exits.

In 2011, David led the sale of Concentric, a New York-based pharmaceutical agency, to the public company MDC Partners. Over the next six years, he supported the founders in expanding the healthcare group's revenue from $12 million to $60 million.

In 2016, driven by a passion for building and scaling businesses, David founded DCD Consulting Group. Known for being transparent, thoughtful, and analytical, David is a strategic and collaborative leader who values talent development and balancing short-term wins with long-term goals.

Bookkeeping / Controller Services Partner

Bari Jamnik

Bookkeeping & Back Office Solutions, LLC (BBOS)

Bari is the President and Founder of Bookkeeping & Back Office Solutions, LLC (BBOS), which she founded in 2009 after earning her Bachelor of Accountancy from The George Washington University. Prior to BBOS, she served as CFO of a mid-sized New York investment banking firm and as Assistant Controller at a NYC corporate law firm.

Over her career, Bari has worked across a broad range of industries — from real estate and venture capital to investment advisory and law — bringing deep expertise in helping small and mid-sized businesses build the financial infrastructure they need to grow. Her passion is working directly with business owners to help them understand and take control of their finances, ensuring the growth they envisioned becomes a reality.

Controller Services
